Outcome 7: Parts A and B (Monotherapy and Combination With SoC): Number of Participants With Serious AEs (SAEs)
Description: An SAE is any untoward medical occurrence that at any dose fulfills one or more of the following criteria:

* Results in death
* Is immediately life-threatening
* Results in persistent or significant disability/incapacity Is a congenital anomaly/birth defect
* Requires inpatient hospitalization or prolongation of existing hospitalization
* Is another medically significant event defined as an event that may not be immediately life-threatening or result in death or hospitalization but may jeopardize the patient or may require intervention to prevent any of the above listed outcomes
